spans.s:
वोर (रः) 1.
m. A sort of pulse.

वोरक (कः)
m. A writer, a scribe.

वोरट (टः) 1.
m. A sort of jasmine.

वोर-पट्टी (ट्टी) 3.
f. A sort of mat
or mattress^1 for sleeping on.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

वोरव (वः) 1.
m. A kind of rice
which is cut in March or April.

वोरुखान (नः) 1.
m. A horse of a
white and red colour.
